'''Boe Vixe''' was a [[Shockball/Legends|shockball]] [[Athlete/Legends|athlete]], the son of [[Rae Vixe]], and the brother of [[Cera Vixe]]. After learning that [[Vee Naaq]] hired a group of individuals to help his sister escape her family, Vixe offered them more to walk away from the deal.<ref name="FP" />
